notes: The first-run password is the database manager's master password, not a user login. Use it to create the first database and choose your own administrator email and password; leave Demo Data unchecked.

The generated master password is stored as admin_passwd in a private configuration file on the owned data volume. Startup atomically updates that setting without duplicate lines, preserving the official addons_path and data_dir defaults and other existing settings.

The official image receives HOST, USER and PASSWORD for PostgreSQL. The startup wrapper additionally uses MASTER_PASSWORD and ODOO_RC to configure the master password before returning to the official entrypoint.
Proxy mode is enabled, demo data is disabled, and workers=0 keeps HTTP and WebSockets on port 8069 in threaded mode; no separate bus port is published.
Odoo 19 requires PostgreSQL 13 or newer. PostgreSQL 16.15 is private to this project's network and persists in its own named volume; Odoo's filestore and configuration persist in the data volume.

The exact official Odoo 19 dated image is pinned even though a newer major exists. The 1g application floor is provisional until measured on both supported Ubuntu releases; tested image lists remain empty until live verification.
